Rows are [page id, old, new, why], in the form latin_audit.py apply takes (EXPAND). "ready": one gap, the editor's form (Cit[ationes]). Forms with two or more gaps are in "ready" too since the editor's ruling of 2026-11-27 ("Each gap should be bracketed": v[e]n[ien]tis). The desktop session copies a holding's rows into units/<slug>/intake/latin_audit.json, less any the page shows to be otherwise.
